water.how: Return to First Shore. Mara can explain what changed; the nearby gate leads back to Stormwood.

stormwood.how: Cross the Stormwood to its Cloudreach return gate, then keep following the road home.

cloudreach.how: Descend to the lower-cliffs return gate and cross back into the Meadows.

meadows.how: Bring the companions travelling with you to Grandpa's home and talk to him.

water.how: Return through Stormwood and Cloudreach to Grandpa's home in the Meadows.

stormwood.how: Use the Cloudreach return gate and continue to Grandpa's home in the Meadows.

cloudreach.how: Use the lower-cliffs return gate and continue to Grandpa's home in the Meadows.

meadows.how: Talk to Grandpa again, then Continue or Skip the credits to return to the same world.
